title: Can the training group recover coherently?
description: Inject a distributed failure, choose DDP or FSDP, and enable recovery controls. The lab distinguishes a job that merely restarts from one that preserves model, optimizer, and sample-stream correctness.

topologies.label: DDP replicas
topologies.detail: Every rank holds a full model replica; gradients synchronize at each step.

topologies.label: FSDP shards
topologies.detail: Model state is distributed; save and restore must preserve the chosen sharded checkpoint contract.

controls.label: Synchronized sampler state
controls.detail: Shard examples by rank, persist the epoch or cursor, and call set_epoch consistently.

controls.label: Complete durable checkpoint
controls.detail: Persist model, optimizer, scaler, scheduler, global step, RNG, and data position together.

controls.label: Fail-fast group restart
controls.detail: Bound collective waits and restart the coordinated process group instead of one rank.

controls.label: Per-rank telemetry
controls.detail: Compare step time, data wait, memory, collective time, and progress for every rank.

scenarios.label: One rank exits
scenarios.detail: A device error kills one process during backward synchronization.
scenarios.symptom: Seven ranks wait in a collective after rank 3 disappears.
scenarios.rootCause: The process group cannot complete the gradient reduction with missing membership.

scenarios.label: Epochs repeat samples
scenarios.detail: Loss improves, but some records repeat while others never train.
scenarios.symptom: Ranks report healthy steps while sample IDs reveal duplicate ownership.
scenarios.rootCause: The distributed sampler, epoch seed, or resume cursor diverges across ranks.

scenarios.label: One rank becomes a straggler
scenarios.detail: The entire synchronous group slows to the pace of one data-starved worker.
scenarios.symptom: Collective time rises on seven ranks while rank 5 spends most of the step waiting for data.
scenarios.rootCause: A slow input shard, worker failure, or device contention delays one synchronous participant.

scenarios.label: Checkpoint cannot restore
scenarios.detail: A replacement cluster starts, but optimizer or shard metadata is incomplete.
scenarios.symptom: Model weights load while optimizer state or FSDP shard metadata fails validation.
scenarios.rootCause: The save path published a partial checkpoint without an atomic manifest and restore test.
